info.name: MY GARB Backend - Milestones 1 and 2
info.description: M1/M2 actual API requests. Run once in order with a fresh cookie jar and fresh rate-limit budget. Recommended: npm run test:postman (local test database, random in-memory password, owned fixture cleanup). GUI runs generate fictional emails and an ephemeral password unless authPassword is privately supplied. GUI accounts remain in the selected server database. Final request intentionally exhausts the default auth limit; wait 15 minutes before another GUI run. Never export populated environments, cookies, or raw run reports. No public admin endpoint exists. See docs/postman/README.md.

request.description: Register customer. Expected HTTP 201. Run in folder order using the cookie jar. No bearer token is used.

exec: pm.test('Exact safe user structure and identity', () => { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.all.keys('success','data'); pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.data).to.have.all.keys('user'); const u=b.data.user; pm.expect(u).to.have.all.keys('id','name','email','role','status'); pm.expect(u.id).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{24}$/); pm.expect(u.name).to.eql('Demo customer'); pm.expect(u.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('customerEmail')); pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('customer'); pm.expect(u.status).to.eql('active'); pm.variables.set('customerId',u.id); });
